(ta)༄༅/ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ ru tra baṃ/ pad+ma nyi zla bdud nag pho mo'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ hrīḥyig dmar nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing chen nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dang*/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo sngo ljang rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ thod pa skam rlon lnga bcu tshar gsum gyi do shal byas pa/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang rin po che'i phreng bas sku la spras pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon po gdengs pas bar snang khengs pa/

zhabs g.yas bskums zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad pad+ma dbang chen gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ badz+ra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po/ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du badz+ra/ kro dha/ ha ya/ grī wa/ hu lu/ hu lu/ hūm̐/ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kha dog dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi rgyud sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ha ya grī wa ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun bdag chos sku pad+ma'i gdung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngams chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas mchod cing bstod/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas// ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la// rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ de ltar khrag 'thung dpa' gcig gi// sgrub thabs nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di// dang po'i las can nyams len phyir// ban+de blo gsal rgya mtshos sbyar// dge'o//

༈ /gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi gtor chog bsdus pa bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo// chos skyong lcam sring la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ mchod gtor rnams phyag len bzhin du bshams nas byin rlabs la/ chos skyong 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa/ rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ pad+ma nyi ma rta ro mi ro brtsegs pa'i steng na/ pram̐ las zangs kyi ral gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing*/ g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon bse'i ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rnam par gtsigs nas ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi beg tse dang dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan cing*/ zhabs la sag l+h+wam dmar po gsol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du mam̐ las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma sku mdog sngo nag gdong pa bse/ so dung*/ smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan zhing gser gyi rna cha 'chang ba/ gcer mo spyan dang zhal bgrad pa/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar ba/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu bgegs la 'debs pa/

dred mo mi zan la zhon pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su pram̐ las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon cing ce spyang la zhon pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar khra ma/ lhor ri rtsi mi dmar/ nub tu kro ti mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag ko sha shar lhor aṃ gri mi dmar/ lho nub tu ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du ha shang mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste gri thogs brgyad dang*/ shan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon la la rgyu ma lag sdogs byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'drad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa ldags pa/ la la sha khrag sbar gyis 'debs pa/ la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/ la la pags pa dmar shus byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po 'ding ba/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog dbugs len pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ ba glang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon pa/ gzhan yang btsan dmar stong*/ bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong*/ ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang shar ma ru tse'i dur khrod brag dmar mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ kyai yul gcig mya ngam 'das bdun pha rol na// mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsigs// mi ro rta ro mang po gcal du bkram// mi khrag rta khrag mang po mtsho ltar 'khyil// 'khor yug zangs kyi phreng bas kun nas bskor// bse mkhar smug po mchong gi ba gam can// thod pa brtsigs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas// chos skyong dregs pa lcam dral gshegs su gsol// 'khor tshogs shan pa'i tshogs kyang gshegs su gsol// zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dul ba dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi las bcol bsgrub pa'i phyir// da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// rings pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// nag po'i phyogs dang gang la dmigs pa yi// gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog

/oṃ rak+mau prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur ston pa// mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i// sgrol ging srog bdag dmar po la phyag 'tshal// bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes srung ma'i tshogs// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum// las byed shan pa gtum po sde lnga dang*// ma mo the'u rang tshogs la gus par 'dud// ces phyag bya/ oṃ rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du shab+da'i bar sbyar la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la nang mchod phul te/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros chos skyong lcam sring gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sngags phreng gis bskor ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas rang dbang med par bka' nyan cing ci 'dod pa'i las bsgrubs par bsams la/ oṃ rak+mo pra ṇa āt+ma k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa lo hi ta sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa yab kyi sngags/ oṃ rak+mo ya ma tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ pra ti de wī hūm̐ srog la ya ma dzaḥ sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rtsa sngags ci mang bzlas pa'i mthar/ chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur pas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigh+nāṃ sha trūṃ a mu ka mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la slar yang phyi mchod nang mchod phul la/ kyai rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru tse'i gnas srung*/ li yul chos kyi srung ma/ ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan/ gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod/

yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can/ yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can/ sras gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ 'khor srog gcod shan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu phang bstod/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ rnal 'byor pa bdag sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs/ zhes bka' bsgo'o// tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'o// ༈ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ yi dam dang 'di nyid kyi bris sku sogs rten gyi drung du/ spyi sgos kyi mchod gtor/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang gi gtor ma che ba mda' dar dang tsa ka lis brgyan pa 'bul gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon gyis yang gsang khros pa'i phrin las 'dzab bstod yan rdzogs par byas/ de nas gnod sbyin 'khor bcas bskyed chog mchod gtor bzlas pa'i bar byas te/ slob ma mdun du 'khod pa la spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ rjes gnang gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag nyid// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// bla ma dge 'dun sangs rgyas bstan// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir// lcam dral rjes gnang bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ chos skyong dregs pa lcam dral ni// khyod kyis brtson pas mchod nus sam// phrin las bcol dang dam tshig rnams// rjes su mthun par bsgrub nus sam// zhes dris/ slob mas gong gi tshig la mchod nus so dang*/ sgrub nus so// zhes 'don pa bsgyur la lan gdab/ de nas bla mas/ snod dang ldan pa'i bu khyod kyis// bstan pa'i spyi dgra bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po'i sgrub pa ngas sbyin gyis// khyod kyi spro bas brtson pas mchod// ces khas blangs nas/

khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs sh+lo ka gcig sngon du 'gro bas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas slob ma stong pa'i ngang las chos skyong 'khor bcas su bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag las rang 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim/ byang shar gyi gnas nas kyang de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim par bsam zhing*/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis mgo drangs nas yab yum gyi srog snying brjod cing rol mo bya ba ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// yang mdun gyi chos skyong lcam dral gyi thugs ka nas srog sngags las srog sngags gnyis pa zhig mched de slob ma'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par bsams la/ lcam sring gi srog snying lan gsum rjes zlos byed du 'jug pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gtor ma slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku khro rgyal rta mchog sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phyar/ chos rgyal bo dong rin po che/ jo sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ slob dpon shes rab 'tsho/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge/ chos rje rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal ba/ gtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ chos rje shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa/

yang rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ 'khrul zhig rat+na bha dra/ rtsa ba'i bla ma blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung bskyab sba ba dang*/ bran g.yog bka' sdod gyis shig ces brjod cing srog snying brjod pas/ lcam dral 'khor bcas 'od du zhu nas slob ma'i snying ga'i sa bon la thim par bsams la/ spros bral gyi ngang du ci gnas la mnyam par bzhag rjes kyi yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen pos mnyes par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi tho yig las cung zad gsal bar ban+de blo gsal gyis bgyis pa la gnod sbyin 'khor bcas bzod par mdzad cing phrin las thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
